metadata.title: CLOPSSEC_ticket_transition
metadata.description: HTTP-triggered Logic App building block for CLOPSSEC ticket transitions. With only ticket_key it lists the transitions available from the ticket's current status, each with its required and optional fields (type, default flag, allowed values). With transition_id and/or transition_name it validates the transition against that list, resolves and shapes every field in the request body against the transition's field metadata, refuses the call before any Jira write when a field is unknown, a value is not allowed or a required field is missing, submits the transition once without retries, verifies the resulting status within a bounded synchronous window and answers with the transitions available from the new status. The Logic App's system-assigned managed identity needs a Key Vault access policy with secret 'get' on the vault holding the Trackspace password.
prerequisites: Key Vault secret '<JiraKeyVaultSecretName>' holding the Trackspace service account password.
KeyVault API connection (this template creates it if absent).
Key Vault access policy (secret get) for the Logic App's system-assigned identity; see logicAppPrincipalId in the outputs.
metadata.author: CLOPSSEC ticket transition

metadata.description: Name of the Consumption Logic App. Pass it explicitly on deploy so redeploys update this instance.
Azure region of the playbook and its Key Vault API connection.
Key Vault holding the Trackspace service-account password.
Trackspace base URL. Production is https://trackspace.lhsystems.com; use https://int-trackspace.lhsystems.com for INT.
Key Vault secret name storing the Trackspace password.
Jira project key this endpoint lists and transitions tickets in. ticket_key must carry this prefix and the issue must still live in this project.
Maximum status polls after the transition is submitted.
Delay between status polls (the first poll is immediate).
Overall timeout of the status polling loop. Redo the 120 s budget in the README before raising it.

ticket_key.description: Jira key of the CLOPSSEC ticket (e.g. CLOPSSEC-46988). Trimmed and upper-cased.

transition_id.description: Optional. Id of the transition to perform, as listed for the ticket's current status.

transition_name.description: Optional. Name of the transition to perform (case-insensitive, trimmed, exact). Omit both transition_id and transition_name to list the available transitions.

fields.description: Optional, transition mode only. Keys are Jira field ids or display names of the selected transition's fields; 'comment' is sent as a transition comment.
